offensiveAbilities.name: Devourer of Swarms
offensiveAbilities.description: The giant pangolin ignores the resistances of swarms, and its tongue Strike deals an additional 2d6 damage against swarms.

offensiveAbilities.name: Emit Musk
offensiveAbilities.description:
The giant pangolin releases a disorienting and repulsive musk within a 5ft Emanation. Each creature in the area must attempt a DC 20 Fortitude Saving Throw save.

The pangolin can't Emit Musk again for 1d4 rounds.

Critical Success The creature becomes temporarily immune to pangolin musk for 1 minute.

Success The creature is unaffected.

Failure The creature is Sickened 1.

Critical Failure The creature becomes sickened 1 and is Off-Guard until no longer sickened.

offensiveAbilities.name: Roll Up
offensiveAbilities.description:
The giant pangolin falls Prone and rolls up into a ball.

While rolled up, the only actions the giant pangolin can perform are Emit Musk and Stand, and it also becomes Blinded and gains resistance 10 to physical damage.

An adjacent creature that hits a rolled-up giant pangolin with a melee Strike takes 1d6 Slashing Damage damage. These effects end once the giant pangolin Stands.

offensiveAbilities.name: Grab
offensiveAbilities.description:
See rules...

Requirements The monster's last action was a successful Strike that lists Grab in its damage entry, or the monster has a creature Grabbed or Restrained

Effect If used after a Strike, the monster attempts to Grapple the creature using the body part it attacked with. This attempt neither applies nor counts toward the creature's multiple attack penalty.

The monster can instead use Grab and choose one creature it's grabbing or restraining with an appendage that has Grab to automatically extend that condition to the end of the monster's next turn.
